newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 25.5 pct of Sovtransavto haulier.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 25.5 pct of Sovtransavto haulier.

text.p: Russia will auction 25.5 percent of the country's largest freight haulier, AO Sovtransavto Holding, the Federal Securities Corporation (FSC) said.

It will accept bids for Sovtransavto Holding, which owns stakes in a number of regional haulers, from December 31 until January 31, 1997 for 107,739 shares at a minimum price of 100,000 roubles per share.
The hauliers work within Russia and internationally.
According to FSC rules, stakes at special auctions are split among bidders and not awarded to a single bidder. Results will be announced no later than February 28, 1997.

Sovatransavto holdings include stakes in AO Sovtransavto-Moskva, AO Sovtransavto-Bryansk, AO Sovtransavto-Rostov, AO Sovtransavto-Smolensk, AO Sovtransavto-Lugansk, AO Sovtransavto-Kishenyov, AO Sovtransavto-ekspress (Moscow), AO Sovtransavto-ekspeditsiya (Moscow), Bryansk Sovtransekspeditsiya, Sovavto-Brest and Vestavto (Kaliningrad).
